descriptionPlain: Description Reach The Sky In Your Hand Collection minted in collaboration with ESO Observatory High-quality digital printing Decoration with magnifying lens The perfect gift for space enthusiasts In each coin in the series you will find a reflection of the distant galaxies, nebulae and stars that fascinate astronomers and space enthusiasts around the world. More than just collectible treasures, this is a visual odyssey through the macrocosm.
